column1: # Which tool each preflight gate needs, read by scripts/cloud/env-check.sh
# (spc-2610120941441282, itd-2610120738075547 C2 and decision 5). A cloud session
# stops before any work only when a tool a gate needs is missing, because its
# hand-back would then fail; a tool no gate needs is a warning.
# One tool per line, three TAB-separated fields:
#   tool    the command, as `command -v` finds it
#   gates   the preflight gates that need it, comma-separated, by their Makefile
#           target names; `preflight` is the steps its own recipe runs (build,
#           vet, test, race); `-` when no gate needs it
#   setup   what puts it on the machine: a step of the connector's setup, or the
#           image the session starts from
# TestGateToolsNamesOnlyRealPreflightGates holds every gate named here to the
# Makefile's preflight prerequisites, so a renamed gate fails there rather than
# leaving this list naming nothing. A tool a gate starts needing is added here by
# hand; that is the cost decision 5 accepted.
# go is also checked against the toolchain go.mod declares, which the setup
# resolves through scripts/pinned-toolchain.sh.
